title: Point a client elsewhere
summary: ASP.NET Core: Point a client elsewhere. Inspect the initial Location header.
introduction: Results.Redirect sends a location. A browser following GET /start reaches /hello.
learningObjectives: Point a client elsewhere with ASP.NET Core

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n School, enter School, and replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. Stop the app before changing examples.

blocks.title: Point a client elsewhere

blocks.text: The redirect response points to /hello. The follow-up GET receives Welcome.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A redirect asks the client to make a second request.
